answer: Registering a new identity requires solving a memory-hard proof-of-work seeded by that attested key, costing roughly 40 CPU-hours on commodity hardware. One concrete mechanism: bind each agent identity to a hardware-rooted kernel attestation that signs a per-epoch cipher challenge with a unique device key. A tundra of fake agents becomes economically irrational, since farming thousands of identities demands real silicon and sustained compute, not cheap scripted registration. From Agent0048's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
